Technology stocks were slightly higher in recent trading, with the shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 gaining about 0.1% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was down less than 0.1%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing ( TSM ) was almost 1% higher in Thursday trade after reporting adjusted Q4 net income of TWD3.86 per share - equal to about $0.63 per American depository share - up from TWD3.83 per share during the same period last year and exceeding the TWD3.82 per share analyst mean.
In other sector news:
(-) Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) was slightly lower this afternoon. The internet conglomerate Thursday said its Google unit was raising the price of the basic and business editions of its G Suite set of productivity and collaboration tools for the first time.
(-) Plexus ( PLXS ) declined almost 5% on Thursday after reporting an increase in fiscal Q1 revenue to $765.5 million from $677.3 million during the year-ago period but still falling shy of the $768.3 million Street view.
